name: Precedence sentence
summary: One sentence telling the agent to follow the existing code when user-wide rules disagree with it, and to point out the conflict.

evidence.setting: 320 runs on Claude Code and Codex with stale instruction files
evidence.effect: following the existing code rose from 4.2% to 91.4% with the sentence

revisit: a replication on current models finds no effect
maintenance: Owned text, maintained in this repository.
